source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The work studies information-theoretic support recovery for dense and independently gamma-sparsified measurement ensembles and gives lower bounds as a function of measurement sparsity.
The paper studies nonadaptive Boolean group testing with near-constant column weights and shows improved COMP rates relative to Bernoulli designs.
The paper proves robust-null-space results and measurement bounds for column-regular binary sensing matrices and basis pursuit.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv companion to Journal of the American Statistical Association 112(518), 2017
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proposes bootstrap-assisted simultaneous inference based on a de-sparsified Lasso for high-dimensional sparse linear models.

The paper develops confidence sets for linear stochastic bandits using a vector-valued martingale tail inequality, consistent with the proposal's standard conditional-sub-Gaussian innovation template.

The work passively observes CSMA/CA traffic patterns and ACK/NACK outcomes, gives graph-recovery observation laws, and treats direct and hidden interference graphs rather than investigator-chosen exact-budget signed response experiments.
